promises.promise: Said he would not allow any acre of Montana land to be sold.
promises.quote: I will not allow ONE ACRE of Montana land to be sold.

promises.quote: I appreciate the support my colleagues in the House are giving to this legislation to advance this bill today, tomorrow, and I will not let up on our efforts to secure a vote in the Senate as soon as possible thereafter.

promises.promise: Said he would continue working with colleagues to advance the Runway SAFE-T Act.
promises.quote: That legislation was approved by the Commerce Committee in September, and I will continue to work with my colleagues to advance it.

promises.promise: Said he would introduce targeted amendments to the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act and keep pushing for a robust amendment process.
promises.quote: I will be introducing targeted amendments to address my concerns with the bill and will continue to push for a robust amendment process to improve it.

promises.promise: Said he will fight to pass the Unborn Child Support Act.
promises.quote: I will fight to get [the Unborn Child Support Act] across the finish line.
promises.assessment: Spoke for the bill on the Senate floor; it hasn't come up for a vote. Assessed by Claude from public records.

promises.promise: Said she will continue to support workers, jobs and job-training resources.
promises.quote: I’ll always fight to protect hardworking Americans, support good-paying jobs, and ensure resources are available to train our next generation.

promises.promise: Said she will always protect South Carolinians' right to keep and bear arms.
promises.quote:
The truth about Annie Andrews: Her primary profession is as a gun control activist.  She wants to gut the Second Amendment and confiscate firearms from law-abiding citizens. 

I will always protect South Carolinians' right to keep and bear arms.

promises.promise: Said he will continue to defend homeschooling parents.
promises.quote: The government does not get to choose what’s best for our kids. Parents have every right to choose a faith-based curriculum for their children. I urge the Supreme Court to reverse the California court’s discriminatory decision. I will continue to defend homeschooling parents.

promises.promise: Said he will continue working to pass the Stop Insider Trading Act.
promises.quote: Last week, Democrats voted against the Stop Insider Trading Act. This bill is vital to restore public confidence in Congress and keep our legislative process clean. I will continue to work to get this passed.

promises.promise: Said he will continue to advocate for fully funding Impact Aid in the Senate.
promises.quote: Good to visit with South Dakota folks representing Impact Aid schools in our state. These funds are crucial for the success of schools located near large sections of federally-owned land, and I’ll continue to advocate for fully funding this program in the Senate.

promises.promise: Said he will work with Senate colleagues to pass the Stop Insider Trading Act into law.
promises.assessment: He pushed for a vote and voted for it; it hasn't passed the Senate. Assessed by Claude from public records.

promises.quote: So until we get some answers, I will keep coming to this floor; I will keep voting to withdraw our sons and daughters from hostilities with Iran.

promises.quote: The Trump Administration is walking back PFAS protections, making NH's drinking water less safe. This is unacceptable, and I will push to overturn this dangerous decision that makes it harder for Granite Staters to access clean, safe drinking water.

promises.promise: Said he will keep working to pass the Bycatch Reduction Act.
promises.quote: We are going to continue this work, building on the work from the legislation we passed for the roadmap to get back stronger salmon runs in Alaska and stronger fisheries with regard to salmon runs across species, across rivers, across the States, but this bill is a really important part of that, so I will continue to work this.

promises.promise: Said he and Senator Johnson would continue their investigation.
promises.quote: Senator Johnson and I will continue our investigation because the victims deserve nothing less.

promises.promise: Said he and Senator Warner would return to the floor to seek passage of legislation if there was no movement on the issue.
promises.quote: And I want to be clear, if there is no movement in the coming days to seriously address this issue, Senator Warner and I will be back on here on the floor, attempting to pass bills to get this done.

promises.promise: Said she will continue working to keep Florida, in her words, the freest state in the nation.
promises.quote: I will never stop fighting to keep Florida the freest state in the nation – a place built on economic freedom and safety in our communities.

promises.promise: Said she will keep working to reduce regulations affecting Florida farmers.
promises.quote: I’ll keep fighting to cut the red tape and outdated regulations standing between our growers and their success.

promises.promise: Said any day SAVE is voted on he will be in DC to vote yes.
promises.quote:
I’ve never missed a vote.
 
I’ve voted for the SAVE America Act six times.
 
Any day we take a vote on SAVE is a day I will be in DC to vote yes.

evidence.description: Voted yes on advancing S. 5271, a bill requiring voters to show photo ID, six days after the pledge. The motion failed 52–46.

promises.promise: Said he will oppose the SAVE Act if it comes for a Senate vote.
promises.quote:
“The right to vote is precious, almost sacred. It is the most powerful nonviolent tool or instrument in a democratic society. We must use it.”

My good friend John Lewis was right. I will oppose the SAVE Act if it comes for a vote in the Senate.
promises.assessment: No up-or-down Senate vote on the SAVE Act itself has happened yet. He voted no on related proof-of-citizenship and photo-ID votes. Assessed by Claude from public records.

promises.quote: As your Senator, I will fight tirelessly to PASS the SAVE America Act, and support eliminating the filibuster to do so.

promises.promise: Said she will vote yes to end the filibuster if that is required to pass the SAVE America Act.

promises.promise: Said he would not stop until a loophole making intoxicating THC products accessible to children was closed permanently.
promises.quote: I am not going to stop until this life- threatening loophole is closed permanently.

promises.promise: Said he would not stop fighting to protect American children from intoxicating THC products.
promises.quote: And we are going to have this fight before the end of this Congress, and I can assure you that I am not going to stop fighting to protect American children.

promises.promise: Said he supports the CLARITY Act and will work to pass it as soon as possible.
promises.quote:
If the U.S. is going to lead in digital assets, we need a framework that is clear, practical, and supports innovation and job creation here at home.

That’s why I support the CLARITY Act and will work to get it passed as soon as possible.

promises.promise: Said she will fight hard to pass the INSULIN Act capping insulin at $35 a month.
promises.quote:
It has become far too difficult for Americans with diabetes to get the lifesaving insulin they need. My bipartisan INSULIN Act would cap insulin costs at $35 per month, ensuring Americans aren’t bankrupted just trying to stay alive.

I will fight hard to pass this bill into law.

promises.promise: Said she is committed to passing the INSULIN Act.
promises.quote:
My INSULIN Act would deliver much-needed assistance to millions of Americans by capping insulin costs at $35 a month. 

With a bipartisan group of cosponsors spanning 21 states and counting, there is nationwide support for this bill, and I’m committed to getting it passed.
promises.assessment: Introduced the bill and got it through committee; it hasn't had a floor vote. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 4189, the INSULIN Act of 2026, as lead sponsor.
The Senate HELP Committee advanced S. 4189 18–4. As of November 2026 it hasn't had a Senate floor vote.

promises.promise: Said he would continue making records public.
promises.quote: And I want you to know that I will continue to make records public because that is what the taxpayers need and deserve and expect.

promises.promise: Said he would use his power to stop a bill that would keep 350,000 Haitians in the United States permanently.
promises.quote: I have the power to stop this nonsense bill, and I am going to use it.
promises.assessment: Said he'd use his power to stop the bill and objected to it in the same floor exchange. Assessed by Claude from the Congressional Record.

evidence.description: Objected on the Senate floor to the unanimous-consent request to pass the bill, which blocked it that day.

promises.promise: Said she would not allow the Postal Service and mail-in voting to be taken down.
promises.quote: I will not allow the Postal Service and safe and secure mail-in voting to be taken down by the obsession of one man.

promises.promise: Said he would continue pushing for prescription-drug reforms and lower costs.
promises.quote: We need the Senate to act on these bills, and I will continue pushing to fix a broken system and lower drug costs.

promises.promise: Said he would put forward a legislative package to accomplish the goals of the Major Richard Star Act while addressing policy and cost concerns.
promises.quote: In the coming days, I will put forth a legislative package that accomplishes the goals of the Major Richard Star Act, and I will do so in a way that addresses the policy and cost concerns that have prevented this bill from passing the House or Senate despite widespread bipartisan support.
promises.assessment: Said he'd put forward a package with the Star Act's goals; introduced it the next day. Whether it settles the cost concerns isn't judged here. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 4744, the Take Care of America's Veterans Act, which includes the Major Richard Star Act.
Senate Veterans' Affairs Committee announcement of the bill.

promises.promise: Said she is committed to policies to reduce regulations and costs for home buyers.
promises.quote: I am committed to fighting for policies that cut burdensome regulations, lower costs, and make homeownership achievable for every Florida family.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the SAVE Act if it reaches the Senate floor.
promises.quote: We should be making it easier for Americans to vote, not harder. If the SAVE Act ever comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO.

promises.quote: I will not support any funding deal that puts money in the hands of Stephen Miller, Kristi Noem, and this violent agency.
promises.assessment: Voted against every recorded Senate vote on DHS/ICE funding after making the pledge. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: If the SAVE Act comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO. I oppose any efforts that jeopardize Americans’ fundamental right to vote.
promises.assessment: No up-or-down Senate vote on the SAVE Act itself has happened yet. He voted no on related proof-of-citizenship and photo-ID votes in 2026. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.promise: Said she would not vote to continue funding ICE until reforms to rein in unlawful behavior and restore accountability were secured.
promises.quote: But, following DHS's actions in Minnesota which resulted in the deaths of two American citizens, as well as repeated violations of the Constitution and defiance of court orders, I will not vote to support continued funding for ICE, which already has $75 billion in guaranteed funding from the bill that was passed last summer, until critical reforms to rein in unlawful behavior and restore accountability are secured.
promises.assessment: Said she wouldn't vote for more ICE funding without reforms; voted no on every ICE funding vote since. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on advancing H.R. 7147, the Homeland Security funding bill.
Voted no again on advancing H.R. 7147.
Voted no on taking up the reconciliation bill with about $70 billion for ICE and CBP.
Voted no on passing that bill. It passed 52–47.

promises.promise: Said he intends to vote against U.S. military action to invade or occupy Cuba without congressional authorization.
promises.quote: Mr. President, I rise to follow the comments of my colleague from the Commonwealth of Virginia, and I intend to join him in voting against any proceedings by the United States military, any action by our President to invade or occupy Cuba without authorization by the Senate, by the House, by the Congress of the United States.
promises.assessment: The only recorded vote was procedural; he voted on the side of letting the war powers resolution proceed. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted against the point of order that blocked S.J.Res. 124, a resolution to remove U.S. forces from unauthorized hostilities against Cuba. The point of order was upheld 51–47, ending the resolution.

promises.promise: Said he intends to keep voting to assert Congress's constitutional role and power of the purse.
promises.quote: So as the question of how we will conduct ourselves going forward in Cuba, in Ukraine, in the Middle East is before this body, I intend to continue to vote for the Congress to take its constitutional role and, more than anything, for us to not hand away the power of the purse to an overreaching President.

promises.promise: Said he would introduce and seek unanimous consent for legislation approving construction of a Presidential ballroom.
promises.quote: This week I will introduce and seek unanimous consent for legislation providing express approval for construction of a Presidential ballroom.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on expanding warrantless FISA surveillance powers.
promises.quote:
The Trump Administration is using FISA to spy on you without a warrant—arming Trump’s lawless federal agents with mountains of data, completely unchecked. 
  
I will vote NO on giving Donald Trump and his cronies more power to spy on Americans.

promises.promise: Said he will vote yes on war powers resolutions to rein in Trump's war with Iran.
promises.quote:
Today, the Senate votes on war powers resolutions to rein in Trump’s illegal war with Iran.
 
I will vote YES—as I have repeatedly. I encourage my Republican colleagues to join me. We know this is wrong—it’s not a partisan issue.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote yes on the day's war powers resolutions and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted yes on discharging S.J.Res. 123, a war powers resolution on hostilities with Iran, the day of the pledge. The motion failed 47–52.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the DHS funding bill lacking immigration-enforcement reforms.
promises.quote: I will be voting no on the DHS funding bill because it lacks necessary reforms to immigration enforcement.
promises.assessment: Voted no on every recorded vote on the DHS funding bill after making the pledge. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on advancing H.R. 7147, the FY2026 Homeland Security funding bill. The motion failed.
Voted no again on advancing H.R. 7147. The motion failed.

promises.promise: Said he would not go along with efforts to weaken ICE.
promises.quote: I am not going to go along with the idea that we are going to give the Democrats the ability to kneecap ICE so they can get amnesty by lack of enforcement.

promises.promise: Said he would not support any additional funding for ICE without reforms.
promises.quote: I have been clear: I won't support 1 more penny for Trump's lawless ICE operation, and yet we are not getting any meaningful response from the White House with respect to the necessary reforms.

promises.promise: Said he will not support a resolution that removes the President's ability to act decisively in defense of national interests, allies, and the Armed Forces.
promises.quote: I cannot and I will not support a resolution that removes the ability of the President of the United States to act decisively in defense of national interests, our allies, and our Armed Forces.
promises.assessment: Said he wouldn't support such a resolution and voted against them. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.promise: Said she will vote to support the President and give him tools to defend America’s interests regarding Iran.
promises.quote:
President Trump’s objective is clear: Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon.

I will vote to support @POTUS and give him all the tools available to defend America’s interests.
promises.assessment: Said she'd vote to support the President on Iran and voted against limiting his war powers. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on discharging S.J.Res. 104, a war powers resolution on hostilities with Iran, the day of the pledge. It failed 47–53.

promises.promise: Said he would vote no on a resolution concerning military action against Iran.
promises.quote: It is, instead, a weighty, deliberate, and correct decision made to protect the United States of America, and I shall vote no on the resolution.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no, and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on discharging the Iran war powers resolution. It failed 47–53.

promises.promise: Continue fighting to keep SBIR and STTR awards merit-based
promises.quote: I will continue to hold this administration accountable and fight to maintain the merit-based nature of these [SBIR and STTR] programs.

promises.promise: Said she would keep fighting to end the war.
promises.quote: And I will keep fighting for an end to this war.

promises.promise: Said she would return to the Chamber every afternoon if necessary to discuss the consequences of the war.
promises.quote: Moving forward, I will come back to the Chamber every afternoon, if necessary, to remind the Nation of the hard lessons learned the last time a President rashly sent our sons and daughters into another unjustified war in the Middle East, trying to ensure that this time we do right by our troops, trying to ensure that this time we actually fully, soberly consider the consequences of Washington's decisions on those who serve and their families.

promises.promise: Said he would work to protect Indiana residents from illegal immigrants, particularly commercial truckdrivers.
promises.quote: While Democrats continue to moan on and on about ICE, shutting down the Department of Homeland Security because of it, I will work to keep the people of Indiana safe from illegal immigrants, especially illegal immigrants who are behind the wheel of semitrucks.

promises.promise: Said he would do everything in his power to prevent measures that would make it harder for ICE to do its job.
promises.quote: I will do everything in my power--and I know a lot of other folks on my side of the aisle will do it too--to prevent that from ever happening because the American people saw what a disaster it was to have Democrats in charge of this country.

promises.promise: Said she would seek inclusion of her Drone Espionage Act in the NDAA.
promises.quote: Florida is home to 21 military installations and three combatant commands—it is imperative we keep our bases secure. That is why I will be fighting for the inclusion of my Drone Espionage Act in the NDAA.
promises.assessment: She pushed for it, but no record shows it was included in the NDAA. It has advanced separately. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Publicly pushed to include the Drone Espionage Act in the FY2026 defense bill (NDAA).
The Drone Espionage Act passed the Senate Judiciary Committee as a standalone bill.

promises.promise: Said he would sponsor legislation to appropriate money for the United States to purchase the Chagos Islands if the United Kingdom divests them.
promises.quote: I will sponsor the legislation happily, enthusiastically to appropriate the money to do it.

promises.quote: That is why I will be voting no on [the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026] unless--unless--DHS funding is stripped out or unless critical reforms are incorporated into the bill.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no unless DHS funding was stripped out; voted no while it was included and yes once it was removed. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.promise: Said she would not vote for the funding package unless DHS funding was removed and reforms were included.
promises.quote: And I will not be voting for this package if we do not pull out DHS and have those reforms that we spoke of.
promises.assessment: Said she wouldn't vote for the package unless DHS was pulled out and reforms were added. DHS was removed but the reforms weren't, and she voted no on both versions. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: I will vote against proceeding with this week’s bill to fund the Department of Homeland Security because ICE needs to significantly change the way it is conducting itself — and Congress should be doing everything it can to make sure that happens.

promises.promise: Said he will continue to support DHS funding.

I will continue to support DHS funding to ensure our immigration laws are enforced and Nebraskans are safe.

promises.promise: Said she would keep fighting to overhaul ICE, reduce its funding, and end abuses.
promises.quote: If it were up to me, Congress would completely overhaul ICE, strip the Agency down to studs, repeal billions in Trump's bloated spending, and end these abuses entirely. I am going to keep fighting for that.

promises.promise: Said she would never stop fighting to get communities, first responders, and people battling addiction the support they need.
promises.quote: The fentanyl crisis has devastated families across New Hampshire, and stories like Anena's are far too common. I will never stop fighting to get our communities, first responders, and people battling addiction the support that they need.

promises.promise: Said he will continue pressing for a Senate vote on the SAVE Act.
promises.quote: I am an original cosponsor of the SAVE Act and proud to safeguard every Idahoan’s vote. We must keep American elections in American hands. I will continue to push for a vote on this important bill with @SenRickScott.

promises.promise: Said he will not support a DHS appropriations bill without real oversight, transparency, and consequences.
promises.quote: Kristi Noem and Donald Trump’s ICE is out of control and terrorizing our communities. With multiple deadly shootings of American citizens by federal agents in Minnesota and no accountability, I will not support an appropriations bill that funds DHS without real oversight, transparency, and consequences. President Trump, Kristi Noem, and Stephen Miller are making our communities and all Americans less safe. Enough is enough.

promises.promise: Said she will not vote to send additional funding to ICE/DHS amid enforcement actions in Minnesota.
promises.quote: My power is my vote as a Senator, and I’m not voting to send an extra dollar in funding to ICE/DHS while they trample on Minnesotans like this.

promises.promise: Said she will keep supporting law enforcement officers.
promises.quote: I will keep standing up for the men and women of law enforcement, every law enforcement officer, because we know that they are essential not only for a stronger and safer Florida but for a stronger and safer United States of America.

promises.promise: Said he will demand a Senate vote on Venezuela military action when the Senate returns.

We cannot start 2026 sleepwalking into another illegal war.

When the Senate returns, I will demand a vote.

promises.promise: Said he would continue the Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations investigation of immigration-enforcement conduct.
promises.quote: I will continue, on my subcommittee, the Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, the work that we have done, the investigation that is ongoing right now.

promises.promise: Said he would vote against a point of order denying that the Venezuela operation constituted war.
promises.quote: Well, invasion of another country, blockading of a country, and removing another country's leader, to my mind, clearly is war, and I will vote against this point of order.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote against the point of order, and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on the point of order against the Venezuela war powers resolution (S.J.Res. 98). It was upheld 50–50.

promises.promise: Said she would keep making the case for a constitutional amendment to overturn Citizens United.
promises.quote: I have long supported a constitutional amendment to overturn Citizens United and restore the authority of Congress and the States to establish reasonable limits on campaign spending, and I will keep making the case to build support for that effort.

promises.promise: Said she would keep working to get her bipartisan bill to streamline VA health appointment scheduling signed into law.
promises.quote: Great news: My bipartisan bill to streamline VA health appointment scheduling recently passed out of committee. This will create a one-stop solution to set up appointments with multiple doctors. I will keep working to get this bill signed into law.
promises.assessment: Her bill, S. 607, the Improving Veteran Access to Care Act, passed the Senate. It is waiting in the House and is not law yet. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov.

evidence.description: S. 607 passed the Senate and is held at the desk in the House.

promises.promise: Work as HELP Committee chairman to pass community health center legislation
promises.quote: I commit as chairman of the Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee that I will work to pass community health center legislation.

promises.promise: Said he would fight to keep oil drilling off Florida’s coast.
promises.quote: Along with Senator Moody, I will always fight to keep oil drilling off of Florida's coast to support our economy, our environment, and our Nation's military readiness.

promises.promise: Said he would continue to ensure law enforcement agencies have the resources they need.
promises.quote: I am going to continue to ensure our law enforcement agencies have the resources they need to keep North Carolina strong.

promises.promise: Said that for as long as he serves, he would do everything he can to give people the care they deserve.
promises.quote: Today, in this maiden speech, I make a promise to the people of New Jersey and the people of this country that for as long as I have the chance to serve here, I will do everything I can to give you the care you deserve.

promises.promise: Said he would care for constituents' parents and grandparents as hard as he would for his own.
promises.quote: I will care for your parents and grandparents as hard as I will for mine.

promises.promise: Said he would bring a sense of responsibility into the Senate Chamber.
promises.quote: I will bring that same sense of responsibility right here into this Chamber with a nation divided.

promises.promise: Said she would introduce the Restoring Patient Protections and Affordability Act the following day.
promises.quote: It is time we approach the healthcare crisis with the urgency our constituents deserve, which is why tomorrow I will be introducing a new bill, the Restoring Patient Protections and Affordability Act.
promises.assessment: Said she'd introduce the bill the next day; it was introduced on December 4, 2025. Assessed by Claude from the bill text on GovInfo and the Finance Committee announcement.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 3368, the Restoring Patient Protections and Affordability Act, with Senator Wyden the day after the speech.
Senate Finance Committee announcement of the bill's introduction.

promises.promise: Said she would keep pushing her legislation to protect seniors from a nursing-home staffing rule until the President signs it.
promises.quote: I will keep pushing for this legislation until the President signs it into law so that we can protect our seniors from a rule that would only harm them, harm their families, and harm their caretakers.
promises.assessment: Her bill, S. 750, never moved past committee, so it was not signed. The staffing rule she wanted stopped was blocked anyway: the 2025 budget law she voted for paused it until 2034, and HHS then repealed it. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records, Congress.gov and HHS.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 750, the Protecting Rural Seniors' Access to Care Act. Referred to the Finance Committee; no further action.
Voted yes on H.R. 1, the budget reconciliation law, which barred enforcing the nursing-home staffing rule until 2034. Passed 51–50 with the Vice President breaking a tie.
HHS repealed the nursing-home minimum staffing standards.

promises.promise: Said he will not vote for a government funding bill unless it addresses health care costs and tariffs.
promises.quote:
Donald Trump knows the Senate can’t pass a bill to fund the government without 7 Democratic votes. So why is he refusing to negotiate?

I will not be one of those 7 unless we address skyrocketing costs caused by health care cuts and tariffs.
promises.assessment: Said he wouldn't be one of the Democratic votes needed to fund the government without action on health care costs and tariffs; voted no on the deal that ended the shutdown. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on passage of H.R. 5371, the continuing resolution that ended the fall 2025 shutdown. It passed 60–40 with some Democratic votes.

promises.promise: Continue working on behalf of Kentucky farmers while restricting intoxicating hemp products
promises.quote: While some may masquerade as advocates for hemp farmers, even sometimes threatening to hold up government funding over this issue, I will continue to work on behalf of Kentucky's farmers while protecting our children not only in my State but in yours as well.

promises.promise: Said she will not support a bill that fails to help Americans afford health care.
promises.quote: I will not support this bill that completely fails to help Americans afford their health care.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on a government funding bill that raises costs and jeopardizes health care.
promises.quote:
As I've always said, I will not support a government funding bill that continues to raise our costs, jeopardizes our health care, and hurts the people of my state.

I’m urging my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to stand up for Americans who are counting on us to lower their costs, and address the urgent, and–in too many cases–dire challenges people are facing in our country. 

I will not let up in this fight.

I will vote no.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no on the funding bill and did. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Voted no on passage of H.R. 5371, the funding bill that ended the fall 2025 shutdown. It passed 60–40.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on reopening the government without a health care deal.
promises.quote:
The vote tonight to reopen the government with no deal on healthcare is a brutal blow to all those who have stood together to save affordable health care for more than 20 million Americans.  

I strived to stop this outcome.  I will vote "NO" tonight with every fiber of my being.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no that night and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on passage of H.R. 5371, the funding bill that ended the fall 2025 shutdown. It passed 60–40.

promises.promise: Said he would introduce a bill the next month requiring teenagers to be charged in criminal court.
promises.quote: President Trump is right. Criminals have terrorized DC for too long. Next month, I will introduce a bill requiring teenagers be charged in criminal court. It’s time for all criminals to face consequences for their actions.
promises.assessment: No bill sponsored by Cotton found matching the pledge. Three months later he cosponsored a related bill, narrower than what he described. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Cosponsored Sen. Blackburn's Violent Juvenile Offender Accountability Act, which eases prosecuting violent offenders 16 and older as adults for federal crimes.

promises.promise: Said he would offer legislation to begin paying people who are working during a government shutdown.
promises.quote: What I will offer is legislation that instead of closing government down further, begins to pay those who are working.

promises.promise: Said he will always oppose adopting year-round Daylight Saving Time.
promises.quote:
With permanent Daylight Savings Time, for three months out of the year, kids in West Arkansas towns like Bentonville, Fayetteville, and Fort Smith would start school in the dark.

I will always oppose any effort to adopt Daylight Savings Time year-round.

promises.promise: Said he would put forward a proposal that federal employees not be punished and be paid during the shutdown.
promises.quote: And I will be putting forth a proposal to say that they should not be punished and they should be paid.
promises.assessment: Said he'd put forward the proposal and introduced it that day. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 3039, the True Shutdown Fairness Act, the day of the speech.

promises.promise: Said she would question administration witnesses and demand answers at a Senate hearing.
promises.quote: I am relieved to announce that just moments ago I secured a Senate hearing in the coming weeks with witnesses from the Trump administration where I will ask tough questions and demand answers on these unjustifiable actions because I refuse to stay silent as our military and our servicemembers' sacrifices are disrespected and abused by a man who was never brave enough to serve himself.

promises.promise: Said he would never waver in protecting servicemembers.
promises.quote: Ensuring that our men and women in uniform have the tools they need to defend the United States is critical, and I will never waver in protecting our servicemembers.

promises.promise: Said he would not vote to give the President a blank check.
promises.quote: Sadly, today, the threats to liberties and the rule of law are coming from our own Commander in Chief, and I will not vote to give him a blank check.

promises.promise: Said she will keep working to protect SBIR-funded technology from foreign adversaries and would not support extending the programs without reforms.
promises.quote: I will keep working to safeguard SBIR-funded technologies from our adversaries and ensure we invest in the best and brightest small businesses so America maintains our technological advantage; however, continuing the status quo is not a solution I can support.

promises.promise: Said he would keep fighting for New Jersey and the American people through the government-funding and health-care fight.
promises.quote: So, yes, I rise today to make that promise to New Jersey and to the American people that I will keep fighting for you and fight with you as we go through this.

promises.promise: Said he will not support a government funding bill that raises costs and jeopardizes health care.
promises.quote:
As I have said, I will not give away my vote to Trump to fund the government for nothing. 

A funding bill that continues to raise our costs, jeopardizes our health care, and hurts the people of my state does not have my support.

promises.promise: Said he will cosponsor the SAVE Act requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote.
promises.quote: Only American citizens should vote in American elections. This is basic common sense. I will proudly cosponsor the SAVE Act, which requires proof of citizenship to register and protects the integrity of our elections.
promises.assessment: Said he would cosponsor the SAVE Act and did, about two weeks later. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Became a cosponsor of S. 128, the SAVE Act.

promises.promise: Said he will keep working to move U.S. Space Command headquarters to Huntsville.
promises.quote:
Huntsville was named the top choice for SPACECOM’s permanent home by the first Trump admin AND the Biden admin.

I will keep fighting to bring @US_SpaceCom home to the Rocket City.
promises.assessment: Kept advocating, and the move he pushed for was announced. The decision was the president's. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Said publicly he'd discussed the move with the president and expected it to happen.
President Trump announced Space Command's headquarters would move to Huntsville, Alabama.

promises.promise: Said she will continue prioritizing tax cuts and reduced regulation.
promises.quote: As your U.S. Senator, I will continue to prioritize policies that promote economic prosperity, cut taxes, and slash nonsensical government regulations.

promises.promise: Said she would continue to stand up against the President's tariffs.
promises.quote: President Trump's reckless tariffs are a national sales tax, driving up costs for families and small businesses. I will continue to stand up against the President's tariffs.

promises.promise: Said he would work across party lines to restore a confirmation process for U.S. attorneys.
promises.quote: As chairman of the Judiciary Committee, I will continue to work across the aisle to restore a commonsense confirmation process for U.S. attorneys.

promises.promise: Said she would keep working to restore common-sense trade policy for families, businesses, and farmers.
promises.quote: So I will keep working to restore common sense and responsible governance to our trade policy on behalf of American families, businesses, and farmers.

promises.promise: Said he would fairly consider information brought to his office.
promises.quote: And while I may not always agree with someone else's conclusions, I will always fairly consider any information brought to my office.

promises.promise: Said he would introduce Senate legislation to send a rebate check to every working person in America.
promises.quote: I will introduce legislation in the Senate to send a rebate check to every working person in America
promises.assessment: Said he'd introduce the bill and did. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 2475, the American Worker Rebate Act of 2025.

promises.promise: Said she would seek to hold accountable any organization or nonprofit found to be aiding people who attack law enforcement officers.
promises.quote:
If any organization or nonprofit is aiding or supporting thugs attacking law enforcement officers, I will make it my personal mission to ensure the organization and its leaders are held accountable.

Not a threat. A promise.

promises.promise: Said he will always fight for Alabama shrimpers and fishermen.
promises.quote:
Glad my bill with @SenTedCruz has passed the Senate and is on to the House.

I will ALWAYS stand up and fight for Alabama’s shrimpers and fishermen.

promises.promise: Said he will keep working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented.
promises.quote: I will not stop working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented and state and local public servants get the Social Security benefits they deserve.
promises.assessment: Kept pressing until the agency reported implementation complete. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Called with Sen. Collins for immediate implementation of the Social Security Fairness Act.
The Social Security Administration reported it had completed over 3.1 million payments under the law, ahead of schedule. Some advocates questioned whether every case was finished.

promises.promise: Said he will work to reverse the Trump administration's effort to eliminate BEACH Act funding.
promises.quote: No one wants to swim at a polluted beach. Federal BEACH Act funding tests water quality & keeps the public well-informed – boosting public health, environmental health, & economic health. I oppose the Trump Admin’s effort to eliminate BEACH funding & will work to reverse it.

promises.promise: Said he would introduce legislation the following week to end birthright citizenship for children of illegal immigrants.
promises.quote:
Unlike liberal activists judges, President Trump was elected to secure our border and deport those who shouldn’t be here. 

Next week I will introduce legislation to end birthright citizenship for illegal immigrants once and for all.
promises.assessment: Promised to introduce the bill the following week and did. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 2274, the Constitutional Citizenship Clarification Act, to end birthright citizenship for children of people in the U.S. illegally, five days after the pledge.

promises.promise: Said he would work with firefighters and first responder groups to introduce a bill increasing Federal penalties for killing or assaulting first responders.
promises.quote: In the wake of that tragedy, I announced that I will be working with our brave firefighters here in Washington, DC, and around the country and other first responder groups to introduce a bill to increase Federal penalties for killing or assaulting first responders.
promises.assessment: Said he'd introduce a bill raising federal penalties for attacking first responders; introduced it two months later. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov and his announcement.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 2278, the Graham Hoffman Act, with Senator Hassan, making assaults on first responders a federal crime.
Schmitt's announcement of the bill.

promises.promise: Said he would vote for the motion to discharge a rescission package and then to proceed to the bill.
promises.quote: I intend to vote for the motion to discharge after much contemplation and to vote to then proceed to the bill, and I do so with reservation.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote for both motions, and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted yes on discharging the rescissions bill. It was agreed to 50–50 with the Vice President's vote.
Voted yes on the motion to proceed to it.

promises.promise: Said he would reintroduce his bill to ban Chinese ownership of American farmland and homes.
promises.quote: I will reintroduce my bill to BAN Chinese ownership of American farmland and American homes
promises.assessment: Said he'd reintroduce the bill and did. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 2258, the Protecting Our Farms and Homes from China Act.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the “Big Beautiful Bill.”
promises.quote: The “Big Beautiful Bill” is a giveaway to billionaires on the backs of the working class. I will vote hell no.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on passage of H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. It passed 51–50 with the Vice President breaking a 50–50 tie.

promises.promise: Said he will continue to oppose the sale of federal public lands.
promises.quote: I always have and always will be against the sale of public lands. @TimSheehyMT & I worked together to block this provision from being included in the Senate reconciliation bill and I will always fight for our MT outdoor way of life.

promises.promise: Said she and Democratic colleagues would continue fighting to fund and improve public schools.
promises.quote: So my Democratic colleagues and I will continue to fight to fund quality public schools, to improve public education in this country-- foundational.

promises.promise: Said he would lead an amendment to strip the sale of public lands from the bill and would vote yes on the motion to proceed.
promises.quote: I have just concluded productive discussions with leadership. I will be leading an amendment to strip the sale of public lands from this bill. I will vote yes on the motion to proceed.

promises.promise: Said he would move his amendment concerning U.S. military action against Iran if the Senate takes up the resolution.
promises.quote: And if the Senate votes to bring this resolution before the body, which I hope it will see the wisdom of doing, I will move an amendment that I have filed with Senators Kim and Kaine that I would hope would receive all of our support.
promises.assessment: This promise depended on the Senate taking up the resolution. It didn't, so the condition was never met. Left as not started. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: The motion to bring up S.J.Res. 59, the Iran war powers resolution, failed 47–53 (Schiff voted yes), so the resolution never reached the stage where his amendment could be offered.

promises.promise: Said he would continue working to ensure law enforcement has the tools, resources, and support needed to keep communities safe.
promises.quote: I will continue working in the U.S. Senate to ensure that they have the tools, resources, and support they need to keep our communities safe.

promises.promise: Said he would seek to block arms sales announced during the trip to countries investing personally in President Trump and his family.
promises.quote: I will personally seek to block any arms sale that is announced as part of this trip with a country that is personally investing in Donald Trump and his family.
promises.assessment: He said he'd try to block the arms sales, not that he would succeed. He introduced a resolution against the Qatar sale and forced floor votes on the Qatar and UAE sales; both failed. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records and Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S.J.Res. 53 to block a proposed arms sale to Qatar, one of the countries on the President's May 2025 trip.
Voted to discharge S.J.Res. 53 (Qatar arms sale); the motion failed 39–56.
Voted to discharge S.J.Res. 54 (UAE arms sale); the motion failed 39–56.

promises.promise: Said he would not expedite State Department nominations until the administration complies with the law and is accountable to Congress.
promises.quote: So I will not expedite confirmation of State Department nominees until and unless this administration starts complying with the law and being accountable to Congress.

promises.promise: Said he would vote that day to end the emergency used to justify tariffs.
promises.quote: That is why I will today vote to end this emergency.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote that day to end the tariff emergency, and voted yes. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted yes on the resolution to end the emergency behind the global tariffs. It failed 49–49.
Voted no on the motion to table reconsideration of that vote, which was agreed to 49–49.

promises.promise: Said he would continue fighting to defend the Constitution and due process rights.
promises.quote: I will continue to fight to defend the Constitution and due process rights of all who live in America.

promises.promise: Said he will oppose any Trump administration attempt to cut Social Security.
promises.quote:
Americans pay into Social Security their entire lives. They deserve their benefits, full stop.

I will fight any and all attempts by President Trump and his Administration to cut Social Security.

promises.promise: Said he would reintroduce his bill banning stock trading by members of Congress.
promises.quote: 100%. I will reintroduce my bill BANNING stock trading by members of Congress
promises.assessment: Said he'd reintroduce the bill and did. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 1498, the HONEST Act, to ban stock trading by members of Congress. It later advanced out of committee.

promises.promise: Said he will always oppose taxpayer funding of abortion.
promises.quote:
ZERO taxpayer dollars should be used to pay for abortions.

Every life is sacred, and I will always fight for the unborn and the taxpayers.

promises.promise: Said he will oppose future efforts to change the law Congress already passed on the matter at issue.
promises.quote: So I do oppose this effort to change the law, and I will oppose, in the future, other efforts to change the law that Congress already passed.

promises.promise: Said he will vote against the Kaine resolution on tariffs.
promises.quote:
Nope, this story is wrong. I was not talking about the Kaine resolution, which I will be voting against. 

Tariffs must be executed with precision to protect North Carolina farmers and businesses who have been hurt by bad trade policies before, including NAFTA.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote against the Kaine resolution and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on S.J.Res. 37, Sen. Kaine's resolution to end the national emergency used for tariffs on Canada. It passed 51–48.

promises.promise: Said he would vote that day to return tariff taxation power to Congress.
promises.quote: I will vote today to try to reclaim the power of taxation, the power of the tariff to where the Constitution designated it should properly be, and that is in Congress.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote that day to return tariff power to Congress, and voted yes. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted yes on S.J.Res. 37 to end the emergency behind the Canada tariffs. It passed 51–48.

promises.promise: Said he and twenty colleagues would introduce legislation against universal injunctions.
promises.quote: Mr. President, today, 20 of my colleagues and I will introduce legislation to stop the abuse of universal injunctions that we are seeing all across the country--all of this to stop the Trump agenda.
promises.assessment: Said he would introduce the bill that day; S. 1206 was introduced on March 31, 2025. Assessed by Claude from the bill text on GovInfo and the committee announcement.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 1206, the Judicial Relief Clarification Act of 2025, to limit nationwide injunctions, the same day as the speech.
Senate Judiciary Committee announcement of the bill.

promises.promise: Said he would introduce legislation to stop nationwide injunctions against the administration.
promises.quote: District Court judges have issued RECORD numbers of national injunctions against the Trump administration - a dramatic abuse of judicial authority. I will introduce legislation to stop this abuse for good
promises.assessment: Said he'd introduce the bill and did, five days later. Assessed by Claude from Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 1099, the Nationwide Injunction Abuse Prevention Act of 2025.

promises.promise: Said she will support law enforcement on border security and fentanyl.
promises.quote: I will always have their backs as we work together to secure the border, end the fentanyl crisis, strengthen our national security, and protect Florida families.

promises.promise: Said he would oppose weakening the False Claims Act and strengthen whistleblower protections.
promises.quote: I will keep fighting misguided efforts to water down Lincoln's Law and build on whistleblower protection laws across-the- board so truth-tellers don't fear reprisal.

promises.promise: Said he will keep working to permanently restore Title IX protections for women's sports.
promises.quote:
It is shameful that Democrats refuse to stand up for women and women’s sports.

This is far from over, and I will NEVER stop fighting to permanently restore Title IX protections.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no if Kash Patel's FBI Director nomination reaches the Senate floor.
promises.quote: Kash Patel is dangerous, dishonest, and unqualified – I am calling for President Trump to withdraw his nomination to be the Director of the FBI, and if his nomination is brought to the Senate floor, I will vote NO. Here’s why 🧵
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no if the nomination reached the floor, and did. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Voted no on Kash Patel's confirmation as FBI Director (PN 1235). He was confirmed 51–49.

promises.promise: Said she and Senator Peters would introduce budget amendments to protect education funding.
promises.quote: That is why Senator Peters and I will be introducing a series of amendments to this massive, misguided budget proposal to fund a giveaway for billionaires at the expense of our kids.

promises.promise: Said she would vote against the HHS secretary nomination.
promises.quote: And tonight, I stand here for all of the children of our country, all of the families of our country, and I will be voting no on this nomination.
promises.assessment: Said she'd vote no on the nomination and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on confirming Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as Secretary of Health and Human Services. He was confirmed 52–48.

promises.promise: Said she would vote no on the nomination of Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., as HHS secretary.
promises.quote: On behalf of every single Marylander who has lost a loved one to disease, every single Marylander who works at NIH or is actively researching cures, every single Marylander who has been led astray by a snake-oil salesman peddling quackery instead of science, I will be voting no on Mr. Kennedy for them.
promises.assessment: Said she'd vote no, and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on confirming Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as HHS Secretary. He was confirmed 52–48.

promises.promise: Said she would vote no on the nomination of Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., as HHS secretary.
promises.quote: That is why, on behalf of every senior who relies on medications to live and age with dignity, every child who deserves the promise of a future free from preventable diseases, and every American whose health and safety depend on sound scientific guidance, I will be voting no on his nomination, and I urge my colleagues to do what they know is the right thing and vote no as well.
promises.assessment: Said she'd vote no, and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on confirming Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as HHS Secretary. He was confirmed 52–48.

promises.promise: Said she would never stop fighting for Marylanders' health.
promises.quote: I may not be able to stop this nominee from being confirmed, but I want every Marylander to know that I will never stop fighting for your health and for the health of your loved ones.

promises.promise: Said she will work to ensure people fighting fentanyl have the resources they need.
promises.quote: I will work to make sure the people tasked with protecting the public from this poison have the resources they need to help.

promises.promise: Said she will continue to support Chris Wright's Energy Secretary nomination through confirmation.
promises.quote: We advanced Chris Wright’s nomination as Secretary of Energy in committee this morning, and I was proud to vote in support. I will continue to support him as he moves through the confirmation process.
promises.assessment: Voted to advance the nomination but missed the final confirmation vote. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted yes on cloture for Chris Wright's nomination as Secretary of Energy.
Did not vote on the final confirmation, which passed.

promises.promise: Said that as ranking member of the Military Construction and Veterans Affairs appropriations subcommittee he would work on national security and veterans' issues.
promises.quote: From this key position, I will strengthen U.S. national security and fight for Georgia’s veterans, servicemembers, and their families.

promises.promise: Said he would continue working to ensure that criminal illegal immigrants find no safe haven in the United States.
promises.quote: The Laken Riley Act was the first bill I cosponsored in the Senate. I'm glad to see President Trump sign it in honor of Laken's memory, and I'll continue working with my colleagues and the Trump Administration to ensure criminal illegals find no safe haven in our country.

promises.promise: Said he would fight to stop the Trump administration's funding blockades.
promises.quote: I am here now talking on the Senate floor because I will fight like hell to stop this or any of Trump's brazen, illegal funding blockades, and I am not alone.

promises.promise: Said he would fight to keep the republic.
promises.quote: Benjamin Franklin put it years ago like this: We have a republic, if we can keep it. I will fight like hell to keep it.

promises.promise: Said that as Small Business Committee chair she would reform the SBIR program to get small-business innovation to the military.
promises.quote:
The SBIR program needs to be reformed to ensure cutting-edge innovation from small businesses gets into the hands of warfighters.

As @SmallBizCmteGOP chair, I will make this happen.

promises.promise: Said he will vote against Pete Hegseth's nomination for Secretary of Defense on the Senate floor.
promises.quote: It is for these reasons that every Democrat on the Senate Armed Services Committee voted against advancing [Mr. Hegseth's] nomination, and I will oppose [Mr. Hegseth] on the floor.
promises.assessment: Promised to oppose the nomination on the floor and voted no. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on Pete Hegseth's confirmation as Secretary of Defense (PN 117). He was confirmed.

promises.promise: Said she would vote against confirming Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense.
promises.quote: For all these reasons and quite a few more, I will not be voting to confirm the extremely unqualified Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense.
promises.assessment: Said she'd vote against confirming Hegseth and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on confirming Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense. The vote tied 50–50 and the Vice President broke the tie to confirm him.

promises.promise: Said he would vote early and enthusiastically to confirm Peter Hegseth as Secretary of Defense.
promises.quote: I am going to vote for him early and enthusiastically, and I urge my colleagues to do the same.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote yes, and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted yes on confirming Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense. The vote tied 50–50 and the Vice President broke the tie.

promises.promise: Said she would vote no on Pete Hegseth's nomination to lead the Department of Defense.
promises.quote: Pete Hegseth does not have the skills, experience, record, or character to lead the Department of Defense. The brave men and women who serve our country need a leader who they can have full faith in. America’s best deserves the best, and I will be voting NO on his nomination.
promises.assessment: She voted no on Pete Hegseth's confirmation, as she said she would. He was confirmed after a 50–50 tie was broken by the Vice President. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on the nomination of Pete Hegseth to be Secretary of Defense. Confirmed 51–50 with the Vice President breaking a 50–50 tie.

promises.promise: Said he would support the U.S. military’s mission under President Trump and Pete Hegseth.
promises.quote: Under President Trump and Pete's strong leadership, the U.S. military will once again become the world's most lethal fighting force that our enemies fear and our allies respect, and I will do everything I can to support their mission.

promises.promise: Said she would work to reduce the size of the federal government and speak against government spending.
promises.quote: As Florida’s next U.S. Senator, I will work tirelessly to reduce the bloat of Washington and speak out loudly against government spending.

promises.promise: Said he and his colleagues would work every day in the coming months to accomplish border security.
promises.quote: That is exactly what my colleagues and I will be working to accomplish every day in the coming months because border security is national security.

promises.promise: Said he would continue work to protect and support law enforcement.
promises.quote: As chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee, you can be sure that I will continue my work to protect and support law enforcement in both Iowa and nationwide.
